problems: The caption says 'thin ice', but no ice appears in any frame. The white flecks from storyboard frame 3 onward look like spilled paint or foam on dark water, so a viewer can't tell that a frozen sea was meant. Without that, the failure doesn't read as 'thin ice gone wrong'.

For the first half (storyboard frames 1-8, and the 25% still), the friends are a tiny tangle of red lines and colours on the far island, half hidden behind the big tree's trunk and the clutter. Nothing in that stretch can be followed.

The camera never moves or gets closer. The only readable action is in the last quarter (frames 12-16), and even there the characters fill a small strip in the lower middle of the frame. Most of the picture is empty, flecked water and the static island.

The 'black slab' is hard to see. At 50% it is a dark smudge beside the sheep that looks like a shadow, and at 75% it is a dark patch under the crab that reads as a reflection or hole, not as an object that appeared.

At 75% and in frames 13-16, the red ropes pass through the blue creature and the crab, and a thin white line runs across the water from the shore with no visible cause or anchor. The two pink animals stand still on the grass while their ropes pull taut down to the water.
In frame 16 the blue creature sinks into a dark blob under the group with no visible cause. The take just stops on a jumbled cluster, so there is no moment where the failure lands.
posts.critique: The caption names the glitches accurately, but the film never shows ice. For more than half its length the action is too small and buried in island clutter to follow, so it reads as an unfocused wide shot of a tangle rather than a failure someone can watch happen.
